prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Houston, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1051; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This call is being recorded for claim purposes. Can you confirm you're okay to continue?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened at the intersection.

A: I was making a left turn at a signal in Houston. The light had turned yellow and I was already in the intersection when the other vehicle came through from the opposite direction and struck the front passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I looked, but I was focused on getting through the turn. I think it was moving fairly quickly.

Q: Where were you coming from and where were you headed?

A: I was heading home from a job site. I was going to turn onto the side street on the left.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did anyone else ride in your vehicle?

A: No, I was alone.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening. They said I had a back strain. My lower back is sore and stiff, especially when I bend or sit for a long time.

Q: Are you currently taking any medication or receiving treatment for that?

A: I'm taking an over-the-counter anti-inflammatory and I have a follow-up appointment scheduled with my primary doctor next week.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct about your account?

A: No, I think that covers it. I'll send over the clinic paperwork when I get it.

Q: Thank you. We'll follow up once we review the documents. This concludes the statement.

A: Thanks.
